proposal_threshold_uni_current.note: Current process (Jan 2023 update): at least 1M UNI delegated to submit an on-chain proposal.

proposal_threshold_uni_original.note: Original process: 2.5M UNI (0.25% of supply). Lowered to 1M UNI by the Dec 2022 governance vote summarised in the Jan 2023 update.

temperature_check.value: 5 days; at least 10M UNI for, and for > against

voting_period_days_summary.note: Jan 2023 update Phase 3 timeframe line states '2 day waiting period, 6 day voting period, 2 day timelock'.

voting_period_days_body.note: Same Jan 2023 post, body text: 'a seven day voting period begins'. The older process docs and the process mirror also state 7 days. DISCREPANCY: 6 vs 7 days within one primary source.

voting_period_blocks_secondary.note: SECONDARY SOURCE (Oct 2026 contract reads): on-chain votingPeriod is 40,320 blocks, closer to 6 days than 7 at current block times. Corroborates the 6-day figure; not a primary source.

quorum_for_votes_uni.note: 4% of 1B supply; only for-votes count toward quorum.

timelock_delay_seconds.note: SECONDARY SOURCE (Oct 2026 contract reads): timelock delay is 172,800 seconds (2 days), admin is Governor Bravo.

grace_period_days.note: NOT SEPARATELY VERIFIED for Uniswap: 14 days is the grace period of the shared Compound Timelock contract; Uniswap uses the same Timelock codebase.

voting_power.value: UNI delegated, snapshot at proposal start
voting_power.note: If the proposer does not maintain their vote weight throughout the voting period, the proposal may be canceled by anyone.

timelock_admin.note: Official technical reference lists the Timelock and Governor Bravo as the active mainnet contracts.

execution.value: any address may execute after the timelock delay

vote_differential.note: NOT PRESENT: no vote-differential rule; a proposal passes on a simple majority plus the 40M for-votes quorum.

guardian.value: Governor Bravo guardian can cancel pending proposals
guardian.note: NOT VERIFIED: the guardian holder / identity was not verified from a primary source at audit time.

guardian_cancel.value: Governor Bravo guardian can cancel proposals

guardian_holder_verified.note: NOT VERIFIED: no primary source used in this audit names the guardian holder.

pause_power_verified.note: NOT VERIFIED: no pause-guardian power is documented in the primary sources used; only the guardian cancel power is documented.

executed_proposal.title: UNIfication proposal
executed_proposal.note: Passed with 125,342,017 UNI for vs 742 against (above the 40M quorum). Activates the protocol fee switch and a one-time burn of 100M UNI from the treasury after the 2-day timelock, plus a 20M UNI/year growth budget.

check_notes.A1-3: No autonomous-proposal path; the 1M UNI threshold is the only gate.
check_notes.A2-4: No differential rule; majority plus 40M for-votes quorum only.
check_notes.A2-5: Jan 2023 process update states 6 days in its Phase 3 timeframe line and 7 days in its body text.
check_notes.A3-2: Grace period 14 days inferred from the shared Timelock codebase, not separately verified for Uniswap.
check_notes.A4-3: Each treasury transfer needs its own vote; no standing per-operation bounds or whitelists.
check_notes.A5-2: Guardian cancel power is documented; a pause power and its limits are not verified in the sources used.
check_notes.A5-3: Guardian holder not verifiable from any primary source used.
